 Advertisement Vermont minimum wage to increase in January
 Advertisement Updated: 4:29 PM EST Nov 9, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Michael Cusanelli Digital Content Manager Vermont minimum wage to increase in January
 Updated: 4:29 PM EST Nov 9, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Michael Cusanelli Digital Content Manager MONTPELIER, Vt. — Vermont workers will see a pay increase starting in January as the state raises its minimum wage. 
 Minimum wage will increase to $14.91 per hour, a 49-cent bump from last year. 
 Advertisement Tipped employees will also benefit from the annual adjustment, receiving a 25-cent increase. 
 The changes are part of a Vermont law that adjusts minimum wages annually.
